headline: Semantic recall@10 0.593 vs keyword 0.203 on 12 planted JDs

public.note: The dataset labels 30 resumes per job out of all that pass its own rule (>=60% must-have skill overlap). In our pool a job has on average 384.46 qualifying resumes but only 13.04 labelled ones, so Recall@10 and nDCG@10 against the labels are capped low for every method. rule60at10 applies the dataset's own rule to each method's top 10 and is label-complete.
